row: Welcome to All Animal Vet Services' YouTube Channel. These videos are meant to help inform you about our services and the high level of client and pet/animal care we offer. We strive to treat every animal we treat with the attention that we'd give our own family animals. Take a look around, then call us if you have any questions or would like to set an appointment. As you will see, we take care of cats and dogs and most family pets, but we also love to work with local farms with their goats, sheep, chickens, rabbits, pigs, cows and more. We can't wait to meet you!  Phone: (845) 255-2900.
